title: 电工实验：基尔霍夫定律（理论计算）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/11_Verification of KVL & KCL Theoretical Calculation with examples Basic Electrical.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/11_Verification of KVL & KCL Theoretical Calculation with examples Basic Electrical/src.py

points.K2: 实验目的：算一算，测一测
points.K4: 稳压电源的旋钮先放好
points.S1: 先算后测，偏差大就停查
points.S3: 电压不超过元件额定值

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着一个节点和一个回路
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a simple junction and a loop drawn on it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天先动笔，算一算基尔霍夫定律！
overlay: 电工实验：基尔霍夫定律（理论计算）

shots.scene: 节点处箭头汇合、回路上箭头绕圈两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: arrows meeting at a junction, and arrows circling around a closed loop. No people.
shots.narration: 一个管电流，一个管电压。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着三只小灯泡，急着要接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds three small DC lamps and eagerly reaches for the wires on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起灯泡就想接线。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，递上一张空白计算纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and hands him a blank sheet of calculation paper and a pencil.
shots.narration: 小研说：先算出该是多少，再去测。

shots.scene: 一本空白理论书和一块实验板，箭头从书指向实验板
shots.prompt_en: A blank textbook icon with an arrow pointing to a lab circuit board icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先弄懂两条定律，再动手验证。

shots.section_title: 实验目的：算一算，测一测
shots.scene: 天平一边是计算纸，一边是电表
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a calculation sheet on one side and a meter on the other, level. No people.
shots.narration: 对同一个直流电路，算一遍，测一遍。
overlay: 实验目的：算一算，测一测

shots.section_title: 实验目的：算一算，测一测
shots.scene: 王老师指着两边相等的天平
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the level balance scale on a board.
shots.narration: 看看两条定律是不是都成立。

shots.scene: 稳压直流电源和三只相同的小灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A regulated DC power supply with blank panel and three identical small DC lamps on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 准备稳压直流电源和三只同样的灯。

shots.scene: 三只直流电流表和三只直流电压表
shots.prompt_en: Three DC ammeters and three DC voltmeters with blank dials lined up. No people.
shots.narration: 三只直流电流表，三只直流电压表。

shots.scene: 万用表旋钮拨到直流电压档
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter dial turned to the DC voltage position marked with a straight-line symbol; the display is blank. No people.
shots.narration: 没有电压表，就用万用表直流档。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源的旋钮先放好
shots.scene: 稳压电源电压旋钮被转到最左边
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns the voltage knob of a regulated DC power supply fully counterclockwise to the minimum position.
shots.narration: 接通前，电压旋钮先放到最小。
overlay: 稳压电源的旋钮先放好

shots.section_title: 稳压电源的旋钮先放好
shots.scene: 老周指着电流旋钮讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the current knob of the power supply and explains.
shots.narration: 电流旋钮按老师要求设好位置。

shots.section_title: 稳压电源的旋钮先放好
shots.scene: 冒烟的电源图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a smoking power supply, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮位置不对，电源可能损坏。

shots.scene: 简化电路图：电源、一盏灯串联，后面两盏灯并联
shots.prompt_en: A simple circuit diagram icon: a DC source, one lamp in series, followed by two lamps in parallel. No people.
shots.narration: 电路是一盏灯串联，两盏灯并联。

shots.scene: 三个电流表分别在干路和两条支路上
shots.prompt_en: Circuit icon with three ammeters: one in the main line and one in each parallel branch. No people.
shots.narration: 三只电流表测干路和两条支路电流。

shots.scene: 三个电压表分别跨在电源、灯1、并联部分
shots.prompt_en: Circuit icon with three voltmeters: across the source, across the first lamp, and across the parallel pair. No people.
shots.narration: 三只电压表测电源、灯1和并联部分。

shots.scene: 并联的两盏灯上方一个等号
shots.prompt_en: Two lamps in parallel with an equals sign above them. No people.
shots.narration: 并联的两盏灯，电压一样。

shots.scene: 电表符号旁标着加号和减号
shots.prompt_en: A meter symbol on a circuit diagram with a plus sign and a minus sign marked at its terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 直流表画图时标明正负极。

shots.scene: 六个步骤图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Six step icons in two rows: circuit diagram, power switch on, knob turning, meter reading, repeat arrow, plug pulled out. No people.
shots.narration: 接线、合闸、调电压、读数、重复、断电。

shots.scene: 王老师检查线路后点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring against a blank diagram and nods.
shots.narration: 接好线，请老师检查后再合闸。

shots.scene: 阿杰关掉电源，拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the power supply and pulls out its plug.
shots.narration: 做完关电源，拔下插头。

shots.scene: 五个同学每人手里一张写着不同电压的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: Five students each hold a blank card with a different small battery icon, standing in a row.
shots.narration: 组里每人选一个电压，各测一组。

shots.scene: 两张空白表格并排，一张画计算器，一张画电表
shots.prompt_en: Two blank tables side by side, one headed by a calculator icon and one by a meter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 测量前先画两套表：理论和实测。

shots.scene: 电压表格最后一栏是等式
shots.prompt_en: A blank voltage table whose last column holds an equation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表格验证V1等于V2加V3。

shots.scene: 电流表格最后一栏是等式
shots.prompt_en: A blank current table whose last column holds an equation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表格验证I1等于I2加I3。

shots.scene: 灯泡图标上贴着额定电压和功率的空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: A lamp icon with a blank rating plate showing only a voltage symbol and a power symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，用灯的额定值求电阻。

shots.scene: 白板上的公式：电压平方除以功率
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a simple formula drawn: a voltage symbol squared over a power symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻等于额定电压平方除以功率。

shots.scene: 三只灯泡下面都标着相同的电阻符号
shots.prompt_en: Three identical lamp icons, each with the same resistor symbol beneath. No people.
shots.narration: 三只灯一样，电阻也一样。

shots.scene: 两盏并联灯合成一个电阻，再和第一个电阻相加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two parallel resistors merge into one, then add to the series resistor to form a single equivalent resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，并联部分合起来，再加串联。

shots.scene: 电源电压除以等效电阻得到总电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a source voltage icon divided by the equivalent resistor icon gives a current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，电压除以等效电阻，得总电流。

shots.scene: 总电流箭头在节点分成两路
shots.prompt_en: A main current arrow splits into two branch arrows at a junction. No people.
shots.narration: 再用分流公式求两条支路的电流。

shots.scene: 两条支路电阻相同，箭头一样粗
shots.prompt_en: Two parallel branches with equal resistors carry two arrows of equal thickness. No people.
shots.narration: 两路电阻相同，电流各占一半。

shots.scene: 两支路电流加起来等于总电流，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two branch arrows add up to equal the main arrow, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 两路相加等于总电流，KCL成立。

shots.scene: 总电流乘第一盏灯电阻得到灯1电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the main current icon multiplied by the first resistor gives a voltage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，欧姆定律求灯1的电压。

shots.scene: 电源电压减去灯1电压得到并联电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the source voltage minus the first lamp voltage gives the parallel voltage. No people.
shots.narration: 电源电压减去它，是并联部分电压。

shots.scene: 两段电压加起来等于电源电压，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two voltage bars stacked equal the source voltage bar, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 两段电压相加等于电源，KVL成立。

shots.scene: 小研把算好的数填进理论值表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills calculated numbers into the blank theoretical table.
shots.narration: 先把理论值填好，下次实测对照。

shots.scene: 串联、并联、分压、分流四个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Four small icons: series resistors, parallel resistors, a voltage divider and a current divider. No people.
shots.narration: 复习串并联和分压分流公式。

shots.section_title: 先算后测，偏差大就停查
shots.scene: 计算纸上的电流值连向电流表量程旋钮
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links a number on the calculation sheet to the range knob of an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 算出的电流，帮你选好电表量程。
overlay: 先算后测，偏差大就停查

shots.section_title: 先算后测，偏差大就停查
shots.scene: 实测值和理论值差很多，阿杰皱眉断电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees a meter reading far from his calculated value, frowns and switches off the power.
shots.narration: 实测和理论差太多，先断电查找原因。

shots.section_title: 先算后测，偏差大就停查
shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰对照电路图一起检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student check the wiring together against the diagram.
shots.narration: 查清接线和仪表，再继续测。

shots.scene: 直流表正接线柱接电源正极，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A DC meter with its plus terminal connected toward the positive side of the supply, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 直流表正进负出，正极接高电位。

shots.scene: 指针向左反打的表盘图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a meter dial with the needle slammed backwards past zero, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接反了指针反打，会损坏电表。

shots.scene: 阿杰看到指针反偏，立刻关电源改线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees a needle deflect backwards, immediately switches off the supply and swaps the leads.
shots.narration: 发现反偏，立即断电再改接。

shots.section_title: 电压不超过元件额定值
shots.scene: 小灯泡铭牌和电源最大输出两个图标，灯泡一侧更低
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a small lamp with a low rating plate and a power supply with a higher maximum output, the lamp side marked lower. No people.
shots.narration: 电源能调得比灯的额定电压高。
overlay: 电压不超过元件额定值

shots.section_title: 电压不超过元件额定值
shots.scene: 灯泡过亮发黑烧断的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lamp glowing too brightly and burning out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超过额定值，灯会烧坏，表会打坏。

shots.section_title: 电压不超过元件额定值
shots.scene: 小研慢慢调电压，眼睛看着电压表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the voltage knob while watching the voltmeter closely.
shots.narration: 从小往大慢慢调，不超额定值。

shots.scene: 电阻、等效电阻、电流、电压四步图标
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: a resistor, a merged resistor, a current arrow, a voltage bar. No people.
shots.narration: 四步计算：电阻、等效、电流、电压。

shots.scene: 两个等式都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two equation icons, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 电流相加、电压相加，两条定律成立。

shots.scene: 计算纸、正负极、额定铭牌三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a calculation sheet, a plus and minus terminal pair, and a rating plate. No people.
shots.narration: 先算后测，分清正负，不超额定。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写满计算的空白纸挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a sheet of calculation paper and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下次实测见分晓，再见！
